items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I remember one guy was named Richardson; he was a trumpet player.

ctx.x: How many pieces in the band did he have?

About six or seven, somewhere along there. I can't remember all the guys. I remember one guy was named Richardson; he was a trumpet player. [ROD ROSSITER PLAYED TRUMPET ON THE 9-7-29 DATE] The bass player was Frazier. And Frazier(?) was a guy that played in all the carnivals. And boy, the way he talked about carnivals, that was a great life. But we...none of us ever played in them... We didn't know what a carnival was. We probably went to see one, but we...
